ORI — IN A NUTSHELL

Ori and the Blind Forest x Kurzgesagt

What if the glowing forest spirit was redesigned as a flat, geometric, thick-outlined infographic bird-universe? Dark space background, vibrant gradients, cute ducks included.

ORI, GEOMETRIFIED

Soft painterly fur becomes pure white flat shapes with a 9px dark outline. Big Kurzgesagt eyes, triangular ears, glow aura.

SPIRIT TREE, DIAGRAMMED

The ancient tree turns into stacked ellipses — cyan to purple gradient canopy, labelled like a science video still frame.

DUCKS INCLUDED

No Kurzgesagt frame is complete without ducks. Two observers judge Ori's light purity from the forest floor.

INFOGRAPHIC HUMOR

Deadpan labels: LIGHT 99.9% PURE, SEIN TINY & ANGRY. Space planets and orbit rings for cosmic scale.

Static demo inside /dist · No build step · Fan-art concept merging Moon Studios' Ori with Kurzgesagt's flat vector cosmos.
